cases.refreshed: Make designs like a sailboat, penguin, frog, or samurai helmet using colorful paper. Then decorate your origami with markers! This is a self-directed program in which all supplies and instructions are made available. A staff member or volunteer will be available for assistance. Registration recommended but not required. Held in the children's area. Recommended for ages 6-12. "Origami for the First Time"; "Origami for Fun!"; "Folding for Fun"; "Origami Zoo".

events.title: Stanford Volleyball Holiday Toy Drive & Picture Frame Giveaway vs. Georgia Tech

cases.refreshed: Fans are asked to bring a new unwrapped toy (newborn to 12 years old) to the Stanford vs. Georgia Tech volleyball match to support local Bay Area families in need. A picture frame giveaway is planned while supplies last, though the email also calls it Saturday's match against 'the Tigers'. The start time was not given in the email.
